chunks: Where they will abide for ever;
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to abide forever in the Hereafter according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the permanence of the Hereafter, distinguishing it from the transient nature of worldly life. It highlights the concept of *baqa'* (eternity) as a divine promise, where the righteous dwell in perpetual bliss and the wicked in enduring punishment, reflecting the justice of Allah. This eternal state is often linked to the spiritual reality of the Ahl al-Bayt, who serve as the eternal guides for humanity.
